tei:p.tei:seg: Bend thy ear, my God, and hear; open thy eyes and see our ruins, and the city which is called by thy name. Indeed, it is not because of our own righteousness that we plead before thee, but because of thy great mercy.
O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, listen and take action, do not delay, for thy own sake, my God; for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.
Our Father, merciful Father, show us a sign for happiness, and gather our dispersed from the four corners of the earth; let all the nations realize and know that thou art the Lord our God.
And now, O Lord, thou art our Father; we are the clay, and thou art our potter; all of us are the work of thy hands.
Save us for thy name’s sake, our Stronghold, our King, our Redeemer.
Spare thy people, O Lord, and let not thy heritage be an object of contempt, a byword among nations. Why should it be said among the peoples: “Where is their God?”

We know that we have sinned, and there is none to stand up for us, so let thy great name protect us in time of trouble; we know that we have no merits, so deal with us charitably for thy name’s sake. As a father has compassion on his children, so, O Lord, have compassion on us, and save us for thy
name’s sake. Have compassion on thy people; have mercy on thy heritage; spare us in thy great mercy; take pity on us and answer us, for righteousness is thine, O Lord, who doest wonders at all times.
